repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR computes the difference as (v1 - v2) where v1 is the initial volume and v2 is the later volume, triggering if the volume dropped by 20 or more. The candidate incorrectly computes (v2 - v1), which triggers when the volume *increases* by 20. Evidence F2 confirms the JoI emitted an action while the IR emitted none because the input held at 20 (an increase from 0), satisfying the candidate's reversed condition but not the IR's.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction order in the `if` condition from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR's definition of a volume drop.
